record.question: Which of the following words differs from the others in terms of the relationship between sound and meaning?
record.explanation: Answer D: Speak. “Buzz,” “hiss” and “whisper” evoke particular sounds; “speak” names the general act of producing speech rather than imitating a sound. Reviewed unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
